provenance.changes: Dissolved the three Paletwa Town wards into a single city outline, simplified for display and clipped inside the source city and the stock Chin province.
provenance.note: The ULA/Arakan Army administered Paletwa at the opening date. The outline is limited to the three wards of Paletwa Town because other Chin actors remained active in the wider township.

provenance.changes: Selected Chipwi Town MMR001005701, simplified for display and clipped inside the official urban boundary and stock Kachin.
provenance.note: The Kachin Independence Organization replaced the local public administration in Chipwi and appointed civilian staff. This overlay covers 100.0% of the mapped Chipwi Town polygon after clipping to the stock province.

provenance.changes: Selected the Tonzang Town polygon MMR004005701, simplified for display, and clipped inside the town and stock Chin province.
provenance.note: The Tonzang Township Council provided town services with the Government of Chinland/Chinland Council after May 2024 and through the opening date. The polygon covers Tonzang Town; authority across the wider township is separate.

provenance.changes: Selected the Kyaikdon Town polygon MMR003007703, simplified for display, and clipped inside the city boundary and stock Kayin province.
provenance.note: The Karen National Union appointed Kyaikdon interim town administrator Soe Khant, who described the municipal public works program in a January 2025 on-site interview. The Karen Human Rights Group reported from the town in 2025, and HURFOM confirmed continued resistance control in 2026. The overlay covers Kyaikdon Town only.
